description: Read-only payout-recovery duplicate guard. Confirms the recorded transfer current state and exhaustively searches Stripe for equivalent live transfers to the same destination, amount, and milestone metadata. Reports whether a human may safely create one manual replacement or must stop and reconcile an existing live transfer. Never moves or reconciles money. Requires payments:read.

approvalId.description: Optional approval id that must match the payout milestone and contract.

invoiceId.description: OpenTrain payout invoice id to inspect.
